law: Use PHASE (Physical Audio Spatialization Engine) to provide complex, dynamic audio experiences in your games and apps.
If the audio in your game or app doesn’t incorporate environmental events or cues, you can use or .
To complement obstacles and indoor locations in your scene, you can use spatial audio to layer environmental effects, for example, a reflection or reverberation, on top of spatial sounds.
For spatial sounds, the framework requires a 3D position from which the sound originates.
